frames.narration: The document is empty and History has no commands yet.
The user types Hello. The UI does not touch the document; it builds a command and gives it to History.
The command performs the action on the receiver.
History keeps the command on its done stack. That memory is what makes undo possible.
Undo. History does not know what the command did; it pops it and says undo().
The command reverses itself on the document.
Redo: History takes the command from the undone stack and executes it again. Any new command type works the same way.
